Raw Project Gutenberg plain-text files are locked by SHA-256 hash for immutable auditability and clean-room provenance.

mandatory_founder_and_legal_constraints.zero_number_66: NEVER use the number 66 or fake statistical mean/median day counts as a universal habit formation timeline rule (grounded in Buyalskaya et al. 2023 PNAS & Lally et al. 2010 asymptotic automaticity curve).
mandatory_founder_and_legal_constraints.zero_word_impulse: NEVER use the banned word across any Focus Pack entry, plain rewrite, or application prompt; always use 'urge', 'craving', 'pull', 'automatic reaction', or 'sudden inclination'.
